ModMetaData.name: EMIBurn
ModMetaData.author: Tuch
ModMetaData.description:
Changes what a solar flare does to your colony.
In vanilla, a solar flare simply shuts all electricity off until it passes. EMIBurn replaces that: power keeps running, but your energized devices can overheat and burst into flame. To stay safe you must manually switch off power to anything you don't want burning.
Power generators (solar panels, geothermal, wind, and modded ones) are never damaged — they're the source you can't switch off to protect.
Fire chance and the random interval between flare-ups are configurable in the mod settings (available after loading a game).
Requires Harmony. Source: https://github.com/Tuch/rimworld-EMIBurn
